name: Edesia Nutrition
old_description: We produce an entire range of therapeutic foods to treat and prevent malnutrition. Since 2010, Edesia has shipped to 65 countries with global partners.
about:
Edesia Nutrition was founded in 2010 in North Kingstown, Rhode Island, by Navyn Salem after she saw a 60 Minutes segment on Plumpy'Nut and recognized the potential to expand its reach. The company operates as a manufacturer of therapeutic foods from its Rhode Island facility, driven by a mission to end malnutrition.

The company produces a full range of ready-to-use therapeutic and supplementary foods, including Plumpy'Nut, at a scale of up to 88 million pounds annually. Its factory sources ingredients from 17 U.S. states and handles formulation, packaging, and quality control for products designed to treat and prevent malnutrition.

Edesia serves humanitarian aid organizations, governments, and global health partners, delivering to communities in over 65 countries facing crises. Its logistics arm coordinates customized shipments by land, air, and sea, while its coalition-building approach tailors nutritional solutions to specific emergencies.

The organization distinguishes itself through an integrated model that combines domestic manufacturing with last-mile delivery, a $9 million innovation fund launched in 2024 supporting research in 13 countries, and advocacy efforts aimed at scaling nutrition programs worldwide.
